description:
[read-only] A brand's segments: one per confirmed offer that names an audience, with its pains, outcomes, proof and the brand website (the default CTA link), ranked shops/commerce first and local services second (each has `tier` and `rank`). Read-only, free. Pass the segment `id` to generate_segment_ad.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/video-studio/segment-ads.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key.

name: list_brand_segments
title: List a brand's ad segments
